name: Oura
short_desc: External: connect your Oura Ring (needs your own free Oura developer app) so Health and your agent get readiness, sleep, activity and workouts (read-only).
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your Oura Ring with a guided setup inside the app. Requires the owner's own Oura developer application and its Client ID and Client Secret (free to create with an Oura account; Oura ended personal access tokens in December 2025) and an active Oura Membership. The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows readiness, sleep, activity and workouts. Keys and sign-in stay in the app.
